# Copilot instructions

Follow [CLAUDE.md](../CLAUDE.md) at the repository root. It is the maintained guide to this repo: commands, architecture (Ansible + Homebrew on macOS and Fedora Asahi Remix, mise, Workbrew), how to add a dotfile, and conventions for shell scripts, Ansible tasks and BATS tests.

Before finishing a change, run `script/lint` and `script/test`; CI runs both.
